title: DEPA: India's sealed rooms for AI training data
takeaways: $500 billion: AI value to GDP by 2030, per the draft report.
2 million requests in two weeks in a bank pilot.
Only 22% of Indian firms have AI testing and audit.
74% say data quality and access need the most work.
Data leaks can cost up to ₹250 crore under the law.
source_note: Sources: MeitY draft via Business Standard; BW Businessworld; ServiceNow 2026; Elets CIO
